cleanup: fixture identities and derived completion groups removed; original policy/groups/slots/counters restored; ephemeral backend login dropped
limitations: Explicit driver invokes the real module; it does not test hosted Cron/pg_net/Edge delivery.
Local PostgreSQL acceptance does not establish hosted Supavisor or certificate acceptance.
Saved recovery is 100 module reads of explicit final facts, not browser/Android rendering or authenticated app transport.
CPU/RSS are local Deno process measurements; PostgreSQL/Edge CPU, Realtime volume and hosted egress were not measured.
The extra terminal tick verifies stopped live demand; future bounded optional completion summaries are covered separately, not excluded forever.
Two live cadence windows do not establish indefinite monitoring or overloaded latency guarantees.
